mapper.sql: id, user_id, request_id, report_type, period_start, period_end, status, content, error_message, zone_id, version, edited_at, previous_report_id, manual_additions, manual_edited_at, created_at, updated_at, error_code, error_stage, source_count
mapper.select: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('weekly-report:' || CAST(#{userId} AS text) || ':' || CAST(#{periodStart} AS text), 0)) IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (id, user_id, request_id, report_type, period_start, period_end, status, content, zone_id, processing_token, previous_report_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{reportType}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, 'PROCESSING', '', #{zoneId}, #{token}, #{previousReportId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reports WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM reports WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT deleted_at IS NOT NULL FROM reports WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET deleted_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND report_type='DAILY' AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'RECORD' source_type, 'DAILY_RECORD' source_role, wr.id entity_id, CASE WHEN wr.completion_result <> '' THEN wr.content || E'\n完成结果：' || wr.completion_result ELSE wr.content END content, wr.project_id, p.name project_name, wr.source source_status, wr.occurred_at source_time, jsonb_build_object('source',wr.source,'taskId',wr.todo_id,'completionResult',wr.completion_result)::text snapshot FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=wr.project_id AND p.user_id=wr.user_id WHERE wr.user_id=#{userId} AND wr.occurred_at >=#{start} AND wr.occurred_at <#{end} AND wr.is_active ORDER BY wr.occurred_at, wr.id

SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'TASK' source_type, 'DAILY_TASK' source_role, t.id entity_id, CASE WHEN t.notes <> '' THEN t.title || E'\n备注：' || t.notes ELSE t.title END content, t.project_id, p.name project_name, t.status source_status, t.due_at source_time, jsonb_build_object('priority',t.priority,'notes',t.notes)::text snapshot FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id AND p.user_id=t.user_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.due_at >=#{start} AND t.due_at <#{end} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='PENDING' ORDER BY t.due_at, t.id

SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'RECORD' source_type, 'WEEK_RECORD' source_role, wr.id entity_id, CASE WHEN wr.completion_result <> '' THEN wr.content || E'\n完成结果：' || wr.completion_result ELSE wr.content END content, wr.project_id, p.name project_name, wr.source source_status, wr.occurred_at source_time, jsonb_build_object('source',wr.source,'taskId',wr.todo_id,'completionResult',wr.completion_result)::text snapshot FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=wr.project_id AND p.user_id=wr.user_id WHERE wr.user_id=#{userId} AND wr.occurred_at >=#{start} AND wr.occurred_at <#{end} AND wr.is_active ORDER BY wr.occurred_at, wr.id

SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'TASK' source_type, 'CURRENT_TASK' source_role, t.id entity_id, CASE WHEN t.notes <> '' THEN t.title || E'\n备注：' || t.notes ELSE t.title END content, t.project_id, p.name project_name, t.status source_status, GREATEST(t.created_at, t.updated_at, COALESCE(t.due_at, t.updated_at)) source_time, jsonb_build_object('priority',t.priority,'notes',t.notes,'dueAt',t.due_at)::text snapshot FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id AND p.user_id=t.user_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='PENDING' AND ((t.created_at >=#{start} AND t.created_at <#{end}) OR (t.updated_at >=#{start} AND t.updated_at <#{end}) OR (t.due_at >=#{start} AND t.due_at <#{end})) ORDER BY source_time, t.id

SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'TASK' source_type, 'NEXT_WEEK_TASK' source_role, t.id entity_id, CASE WHEN t.notes <> '' THEN t.title || E'\n备注：' || t.notes ELSE t.title END content, t.project_id, p.name project_name, t.status source_status, t.due_at source_time, jsonb_build_object('priority',t.priority,'notes',t.notes,'dueAt',t.due_at)::text snapshot FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id AND p.user_id=t.user_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='PENDING' AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at >=#{start} AND t.due_at <#{end} ORDER BY t.due_at, t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_sources (id, report_id, source_type, source_role, entity_id, content, project_id, project_name, source_status, source_time, snapshot) SELECT #{id}, r.id, #{source.sourceType}, #{source.sourceRole}, #{source.entityId}, #{source.content}, #{source.projectId}, #{source.projectName}, #{source.sourceStatus}, #{source.sourceTime}, CAST(#{source.snapshot} AS jsonb) FROM reports r WHERE r.id=#{reportId} AND r.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, source_type, source_role, entity_id, content, project_id, project_name, source_status, source_time, snapshot::text snapshot FROM report_sources WHERE report_id=#{reportId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reports r WHERE r.id=report_sources.report_id AND r.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY source_time, source_role, id

SELECT id, report_id, source_type, source_role, entity_id, content, project_id, project_name, source_status, source_time, snapshot::text snapshot FROM report_sources WHERE report_id=#{reportId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reports r WHERE r.id=report_sources.report_id AND r.user_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY source_time, source_role, id
SELECT count(*) FROM report_sources WHERE report_id=#{reportId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reports r WHERE r.id=report_sources.report_id AND r.user_id=#{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET source_count=#{sourceCount} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE reports SET status='SUCCEEDED', content=#{content}, error_message=NULL, processing_token=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status='PROCESSING' AND processing_token=#{token}
UPDATE reports SET content=#{content}, version=version+1, edited_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND version=#{version}
